# `foxglove completion powershell`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](completion.md)

```text
Generate completions for PowerShell

Usage: foxglove completion powershell [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --no-descriptions[=<NO_DESCRIPTIONS>]
          Disable completion descriptions

          [default: false]

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
